citation: For conspicuous and repeated actions of valour during extended duty in the Capellan theatre during [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreOpRAT],Operation RAT]], House Davion awards {COMPANY.CompanyName} the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDecoration_Davion_SunburstDiamond],Diamond Sunburst]]. {COMPANY.CompanyName} served with distinction and dedication beyond the regular call of duty in the Battles of Algol, Ningpo, Slocum and Azha, and their efforts in service to the Federated Suns will not soon be forgotten.
